description: The U.S. import duty on an HTS line for goods from a given country on a given date, read from the USITC schedule in force that day: the general or column 2 base rate, special-program rates, and every additional Chapter 99 duty that reaches the code and country (Section 301, Section 232, IEEPA and reciprocal tariffs) with its heading, rate, dates and why it applies. Gives a total only when the schedule settles it, and says why otherwise. Use search_tariff_codes to find a code.

code.description: HTS line with 8 or 10 digits, e.g. 8471.30.01 or 0306.17.00.

country.description: Country of origin, ISO two-letter code (CN, MX, DE) or name (China).

name: tariff_duty
title: Duty on a tariff code
